## Contribution

- Related issue (if any):
- Type: code/docs / research cycle / independent evidence review
- Bounded change and reason:
- Author/tool/model and role (or human-only):
- What remains uncertain or out of scope:

## Checks and evidence

- Commands run and exact results:
- Reproduction inputs / commit / artifact hashes where applicable:
- Counterexamples or failure cases checked:
- Verification independence (same author, different method, separate reviewer, or kernel):

## Review gate

- [ ] I checked existing issues and PRs for overlapping work.
- [ ] I am authorized to submit this work and included required attribution.
- [ ] No secrets, unsafe execution hooks, unlicensed captures, or unrelated changes.
- [ ] Applicable Ruff, mypy, tests or documentation checks pass; skipped checks explained.
- [ ] No unauthorized automatic merge, imported-status promotion, or
      parent-problem solution claim. The reserved hourly branch follows its
      separately documented gated autonomous-merge policy.
- [ ] For research packets: exact snapshot, two lanes, distinct evidence, cycle validation,
      canonical manifest verification, then history/README recording. For code/docs: N/A.

Research packets must also satisfy `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/research-cycle.md`.
Passing CI is not mathematical proof. External contributions remain
human-reviewed; reserved-loop integration does not verify mathematical claims.
